edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.mechanism: Because PSA is organ-sensitive but not cancer-specific, it identifies many indolent tumors that would never have threatened health.
edges.summary: The anchor for this edge is the 2026 Bennett systematic review in Curr Oncol, which suggests that psa screening tracks with higher risk or worse outcomes for overdiagnosis. Later papers point in much the same direction, so the live uncertainty is usually about effect size or which subgroups carry the signal most strongly.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
